testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-01 Commit the intended inference settings: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-01 Commit the intended inference settings ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And Infer constraints and Persist constraints are checked ✔ When the user open Constraint Settings to Inference ✔ And the user clear Infer constraints and accept ✔ And the user reopen the Inference tab ✔ Then Infer constraints is unchecked ✔ And Persist constraints is unchecked and disabled ✔ When the user enable Infer constraints ✔ Then Persist constraints becomes available and remains unchecked ✔ When the user check Persist constraints and accept ✔ Then both settings are restored

testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-03 Cancel changes to inference configuration: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:31:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-03 Cancel changes to inference configuration ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And Infer constraints, Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked ✔ And Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected ✔ When the user open Constraint Settings to Inference and click Clear All ✔ Then all nine inference types are unchecked ✔ When the user click Select All and clear Infer constraints ✔ Then Persist constraints, the checked inference types and bulk-selection buttons are disabled ✔ And the priority choices remain available ✔ When the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Settings to Inference ✔ Then Infer constraints, Persist constraints and all nine inference types are checked ✔ And Parallel and perpendicular priority remains selected

testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-06 Cancel Relax Mode configuration changes: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:45:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-06 Cancel Relax Mode configuration changes ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And Relax Mode is disabled with twelve removal choices ✔ And Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled ✔ When the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode and enable Relax Mode ✔ Then the removal choices, bulk-selection buttons and equation-preservation option become available ✔ When the user click Clear All and wait for settled painting ✔ Then all twelve removal choices are unchecked ✔ When the user click Select All ✔ Then all twelve removal choices are checked ✔ When the user clear Preserve dimensions with equation ✔ Then the twelve removal choices remain checked ✔ When the user click Cancel and reopen Constraint Settings to Relax Mode ✔ Then Relax Mode is disabled and the original removal choices are restored ✔ And Preserve dimensions with equation is checked and disabled

testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-07 Inspect restored settings through Application Options: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:62:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-07 Inspect restored settings through Application Options ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited and the Tools ribbon visible ✔ When the user open Application Options to Sketch and Constraint Settings ✔ Then Edit dimension when created and Create dimensions from input values are checked ✔ And Warn of overconstrained condition is selected ✔ When the user choose Inference ✔ Then Infer constraints and Persist constraints and all nine types are checked ✔ And Parallel and perpendicular priority is selected ✔ When the user choose Relax Mode ✔ Then Enable Relax Mode is unchecked and its dependent controls are disabled ✔ When the user click Cancel and close Application Options ✔ Then the sketch returns to Ready

testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-09 Retain Relax Mode after accepting and restore it: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:92:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-09 Retain Relax Mode after accepting and restore it ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/constraint-settings/constraint-settings-line.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And Relax Mode is disabled with the recorded removal choices ✔ And Preserve dimensions with equation is checked ✔ When the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode, enable Relax Mode and accept ✔ And the user reopen Constraint Settings to Relax Mode ✔ Then Enable Relax Mode remains checked ✔ When the user clear Enable Relax Mode and accept ✔ Then the original disabled preference is restored

testcase.name: Scenario: constraint-settings-10 Inspect initial Relax Mode removal choices: tmp/obk-constraint-native-4158/features/sketch/constraint-settings/scenario.feature:102:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: constraint-settings-10 Inspect initial Relax Mode removal choices ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And Relax Mode is initially disabled ✔ When the user open Constraint Settings to Relax Mode and enable Relax Mode ✔ Then Coincident, Tangent, Smooth(G2) and Symmetric are unchecked ✔ And Collinear, Concentric, Horizontal, Vertical, Parallel, Perpendicular, Equal and Fix are checked ✔ And Preserve dimensions with equation is checked
